tree.heading: Federal Charter.—
tree.text: Non Commissioned Officers Association of the United States of America, Incorporated (in this chapter, the “corporation”), a nonprofit corporation incorporated in Texas, is a federally chartered corporation.

tree.heading: Expiration of Charter.—
tree.text: If the corporation does not comply with any provision of this chapter, the charter granted by this chapter expires.
